digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration and Pydantic AI integration
propositions: RP-01 proposes replacing Rebar's bespoke structured-output orchestration with Pydantic AI seams while preserving historical behavior around deterministic repair, extraction, refusal/truncation, retry limits, output budgets, provider fallback, and failure taxonomy

The offline integration probe exercises real Pydantic AI 1.107.2 Agent, PromptedOutput, NativeOutput, FallbackModel, UsageLimits, and event-stream seams without live model calls, validating 32 declared scenarios against current Rebar test and ticket evidence

Seven maintainer decisions were approved: one operation-wide request budget; complete failed response only on proven fit; bounded output-size retry; terminal refusal/filter; aggregate successful-run usage; exact cause-chain exception restoration; and trace-based candidate observability
Implementation of RP-01 is gated on ticketization in the parallel pydantic-ai lane and does not proceed from this research phase without further planning
